model: ISC DHCP server (dhcpd -4), Debian 12 package isc-dhcp-server 4.4.3-P1-2

capture.command: apt-get install isc-dhcp-server; dhcpd -4 -f -d -cf /etc/dhcp/dhcpd.conf -lf /var/lib/dhcp/dhcpd.leases eth0 on docker network fxlab-e (server 10.250.70.67); three busybox:1.37 (busybox@sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec) clients ran `udhcpc -i eth0 -f -q -n -x hostname:<name> -s /bin/true` for web-01, app-02, printer-03 and obtained real leases; then the collector's exact dhcp.IscScript("/etc/dhcp/dhcpd.conf", "/var/lib/dhcp/dhcpd.leases") was fed to `docker exec -i fxlab-e-dhcp sh` and stdout saved unmodified.

files.name: transcript.txt
files.description: stdout of IscScript: @@OPENMAP:config@@ (dhcpd.conf) and @@OPENMAP:leases@@ (dhcpd.leases written by dhcpd)
